verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents workspaces, separate state per environment, or stack separation for dev/staging/prod. The only related mention is provider-level for_each generation promoted for multi-environment setups, which is an adjacent feature and does not deliver separate stacks or workspaces. Missing for 10: documented workspace or stack mechanism, per-environment state isolation, per-environment variable/config separation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can manage per-environment configuration (dev, staging, prod) as separate stacks or workspaces
